name: Waveshare PhotoPainter 7.3"
description: 7.3 inch 6-colour Spectra E6 ePaper photo frame, ESP32-S3, battery-powered (800x480). Speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API and paints a raw 4-bpp Spectra 6 buffer (192000 bytes) produced by the esp32_bin renderer. Same wire contract as the Seeed reTerminal E1002; the two panels are byte-compatible on the frame side. The PhotoPainter mounts its panel 180 deg in the case and the firmware rotates on-device, so the server renders in normal top-left orientation (no pre-rotate here).
notes_md: Confirmed on real hardware running tesserae-device-firmware. Palette nibbles align with the firmware's Spectra 6 constants byte-for-byte (black=0x0, white=0x1, yellow=0x2, red=0x3, blue=0x5, green=0x6; 0x4 and 0x7 reserved), and the buffer is byte-identical to the Seeed reTerminal E1002 output at 800x480: two pixels per byte, high nibble = LEFT (even column), low nibble = RIGHT (odd column), row-major, 400 bytes per row, top-left origin. Do not pre-rotate at render time even though the panel mounts 180 deg physically; the firmware rotates on-device.
